what: Hovering the cursor over a photo makes a round glass of 84px radius snap straight to the cursor position and show what is beneath at 2.2x — the glass appears in .25s and scales .6→1 (.35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)), has a 6px accent dot at the center, and the cursor hides

options.r: Glass radius (px), default 84 — the original journal card is 64
options.[data-fx-part=image]: (If any) child to scale — if none, the first child

note: Not applied on touch devices (photo stays visible as is)

from.where: index.html work card photo (r 84)·journal card (r 64), detail.html photo
